name: Angelwood
description: Client portal and client operations for agencies and service businesses. Ask about your clients, projects, open tasks and invoices in Angelwood from any AI assistant: who owes what, what is overdue, and what is open for each client.
author: Angelwood (New Odyssey)

tools.name: angelwood_whoami
tools.description: Returns the signed-in Angelwood user and the organizations (agencies) they belong to, with their role in each. Call it first when you belong to more than one organization.

tools.name: angelwood_search_clients
tools.description: Lists the organization's active clients, optionally filtered by a search over client name and email. Use it to find a client_id for the other tools. Sorted by name.

tools.name: angelwood_get_client_overview
tools.description: Returns one client with their contact details, their most recently updated projects, and an invoice summary: count and total per status, plus the outstanding balance still owed.

tools.name: angelwood_list_projects
tools.description: Lists the organization's projects with their client, status, dates, hour budget and number of open tasks. Filter by client, status or a search over the project name. Most recently updated first.

tools.name: angelwood_list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks across the organization's projects, soonest due date first. Returns open tasks (todo, in progress, blocked) by default; pass a status to see one status, including completed.

tools.name: angelwood_list_invoices
tools.description: Lists the organization's invoices with client, project, amount, amount paid and balance due, newest first. Filter by status, client or project, or ask for overdue invoices only.
